notes.title: A Small Robot Story is now free + new game demo!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

At this point, I've decided to make A Small Robot Story a free-to-play game. You can download and play it for free here on Steam or on Itch.io.

Along with this, I just published a demo for my new game entitled "Chronoweaver's Loop". Feel free to check that [url=https://bclikesyou.itch.io/chronoweavers-loop-demo]out over on itch.io[/url]. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31222259/d94f4174393282315f90d2c2939b2cb84b30bf2d.png[/img]

notes.title: Ver. 1.0.1 published
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I hope your holidays went well and you found some time to eat some treats, hang with the people you want to hang with, and relax!

Just a quick update on Ver 1.0.1: this is an update that fixes some release bugs. They are as follows:

[list]
    [*]Adjusted gamepad analog stick deadzone. Down or Up on the analog stick won't make you move now.
    [*]You can now look with Shift + arrow keys
    [*]Charge shot animation won't lock with gamepad
    [*]Small enemy bugs fixed (Level 3 enemies won't get stuck)
    [*]Small art and tile art edits
[/list]

Feel free to reach out with any other bugs or issues you find. Post a screenshot, make a gif, whatever works!

notes.title: A Small Robot Story v1.0 has been released!
notes.content:
[img=https://i.imgur.com/6Wh9faz.gif][/img]

Hey everyone!

The story about a small robot that I started 2.5 years ago is finished! If you bought it, I hope you like it. 

From 2003-2005, I was in a band called Tomorrow is Forever. We wrote an album that was a concept album about two friends who became game developers and how their game became became very popular and how that changed everything from there on. We had music videos for every song and even made a Flash version of the game in the story. If you'd like to watch the music videos, you can [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLE454838A190D296A]do that here.[/url]

In summer of 2015, I decided that I wanted to make a game after making music for video games for a few years. I thought it would only be appropriate to revisit this world from 10 years prior.

So here we are. A retro-platformer which is actually a love-letter to 3 of the closest friends I had, how we toured across the country, and all the music we wrote.

I plan to continue supporting this game and have ideas for content that I'd like to add over the coming months. I will obviously be fixing any bugs and issues that arise as well.

Feel free to reach out in the forums or on Twitter: @bclikesyou.

<3 bc <3
